name: Till Modifier Controls and Admin Layout Entry
notes: Frontend-only Till layout refinement. Loyalty and Staff Discount remain a two-column modifier row above totals but are no longer height-clipped on short iPad viewports. The permanent Edit menu layout launcher is removed from the selling screen and replaced with Edit Till layout in Menu Admin; it opens the Till directly in protected layout-edit mode after unsaved Admin changes are safely handled. Existing compatible Apps Script backends 3.13.16, 3.13.17 and 3.13.18 remain supported; included Code.gs remains 3.13.18 and unchanged. Database remains 1.0.6.
